description: This Python source file defines a utility class 'GPULimits' that provides methods to query and compute various theoretical hardware limits and performance metrics for Nvidia GPU devices, such as FLOPs, memory bandwidth, and tensor core performance. It includes device-specific data, methods for fetching device properties, and calculations for FLOPs and bandwidth based on device attributes.

classes.name: GPULimits
classes.description: A utility class for obtaining and calculating Nvidia GPU theoretical performance limits, including FLOPs, memory bandwidth, and tensor core efficiency.

methods.description: Returns the number of FMA instructions retired per cycle per SM for a given data type when tensor cores are not used.

methods.description: Returns the number of FMA instructions retired per cycle per SM for a given data type when tensor cores are used.

methods.description: Calculates the theoretical TFLOPS per second for the GPU, optionally using tensor cores.
